title: GO tell it to all the world

lines.text: GO tell it to all the world Spread the gospel all around Listening ears shall be opened Receptive hearts shall be saved.
Christ Jesus our Saviour Lord Whom we worship resurrects His sacrifice receiveth For the sins of sinful world.
He arose to die no more Firstborn amongst all the dead Whosoever shall believe Such shall live e'en though is dead.
